senses.zh_definition: 待核实的外语转写形式；在韩语语境中，gyeong 可对应音节 경，但仅凭此拼写无法确定完整词语、姓名或具体含义。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved romanized form; in Korean contexts, gyeong can represent 경, but its lexical meaning or referent requires the original context.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tulisan Rumi yang belum dikenal pasti rujukannya; dalam konteks bahasa Korea, gyeong boleh mewakili suku kata 경, tetapi maknanya memerlukan perkataan atau nama asal yang lengkap.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 仅表示对字符串本身的元语言指称，不是对原韩语形式的词性认证。没有依据将其标为官方马来语词条，也不能直接指定某个汉字或中文词义。以下组合只用于讨论该转写形式，不是高频词汇搭配。韩语转写依据见 [韩国国立国语院罗马字表记规则](https://www.korean.go.kr/front_eng/roman/roman_01.do)。

etymology.historical_story: Korean romanization represents sounds with Latin letters, allowing Korean names and words to circulate in texts written in other languages. Under the Revised Romanization system, gyeong can correspond to 경. That correspondence alone does not establish a meaning: the full Korean word, and sometimes its associated Chinese characters, must first be identified. [Source](https://www.korean.go.kr/front_eng/roman/roman_01.do)
